# One Repository at the Workspace Folder

`git init` went at `vs-llm-orchestrator/`, one level **above** the product folder
`agent-orchestrator/`, and one repository holds the product, the documentation set and the tooling.

## Why not at the product folder

Because the documentation set is not part of the product. The SRS, architecture document, security
model, test plan, risk register, release procedure and nine ADRs describe the product but do not ship
inside the `.vsix`; the `Makefile`, the PowerShell runner and the CI workflow build it from outside.
Rooting the repository at `agent-orchestrator/` would either strand all of that outside version
control or force it into the packaged artifact.

The cost is one confusing sentence that has to be said on the front page: **the repository folder is
`vs-llm-orchestrator`, the product inside it is `agent-orchestrator`.** Saying it once beats a rename
that breaks every path in a working install.

## What that makes the root

The root is a workspace, and it is where the reader arrives — so it carries the front-door README,
and the extension has its own text-only one for the Marketplace listing.
It also means `.gitignore` decisions are made at the workspace level, and two of them are worth
recording:

- **`harness/shots/` is ignored** — regenerated output of the screenshot matrix, one command away.
- **`docs/img/` is not** — the twelve curated figures the documentation embeds. A reader cloning the
  repository must see them, and a reader browsing on the web must be served them.

Same file type, opposite decisions, because one is a build artifact and the other is content
([[generated-artifact-with-pristine-source]]).

Also excluded deliberately: four built `.vsix` files, and `.vscode/settings.json` — which is exactly
where an [[openrouter]] key ends up when someone skips the secure command
([[secrets-from-environment-only]]).

## The side effect that mattered here

This wiki's `verify-sources` gate had `vs-llm-orchestrator` marked *"not a git repo — cannot be
verified either way"*. Initialising it closed that gate — 164 files, 27,434 insertions, one commit
([[import-finished-work-into-git]]).

## Rejected

**A monorepo of several products.** There is one product.
**Submodules for the skill bundle.** Vendored with provenance instead —
[[agent-skills-checked-into-the-repo]], [[provenance-notice-file]].
